overview.description: The Virtus InfraCap Preferred and Income Securities ETF (VPFF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in US preferred and hybrid securities. The fund seeks a high level of current income, with capital appreciation as a secondary objective. VPFF was launched on Jul 14, 2026 and is issued by Virtus Investment Partners.
